Callout.Name: Allergic Reaction
Callout.Message: Person swollen after eating, struggling to swallow.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, epinephrine not used, restaurant staff on scene.
Callout.Patient: It is going down. I can swallow again.

Lines.Approach: Swelling fast and she has not used a pen. This is the one that goes wrong if nobody gets there.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
